about: Configuration policy vectors (core/configpolicy.h). Asserted by test/native/tests.cpp against the firmware code and by test/e2e/run.mjs against the simulator (device-sim.mjs). Each case starts from base, applies set (dotted path -> value; null removes the key), runs the policy for chip with password as the admin password in force (stored, as on the device, as its Digest HA1; it must be changed first when mustchange is true or, if mustchange is absent, when password is the factory or a too-short one), and expects problem (exact message, or null) and, when accepted, the values in expect.

cases.name: fresh browser sends the UI default admin: current password kept
old backup with a short password: current kept, with a warning
settings carrying a new, acceptable admin password: current kept, with a warning (only setpassword changes it)
no admin password set yet
cases.problem: Set an admin password first (Change Password)

cases.name: settings carrying the current admin password typed out: kept, no warning
settings carrying the stored hash (a masked password merged back): kept, no warning
a backup carrying a must-change flag: cleared, the password in force kept
stored password flagged must-change: refused whatever it is
cases.problem: Set an admin password first (Change Password)
